ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is a square grid, divided by 3 vertical lines and 3 horizontal lines into 4 columns and 4 rows, for a total of 16 small squares; on each horizontal grid line there are 5 grid points. Reasoning: Divide this 4×4 chessboard horizontally into upper and lower two 2×4 strips. First look at any one 2×4 strip: the diagonal of each small square in it will have exactly one endpoint falling on the middle horizontal grid line of this strip. This middle horizontal grid line has only 5 grid points, and the problem requires that any two diagonals have no common point, including endpoints, so within the same 2×4 strip at most 5 diagonals can be drawn. Therefore the upper part has at most 5, the lower part has at most 5, and the total is at most 5+5=10. Now explain that 10 can be achieved. Take the upper-left corner as the coordinate origin, and the grid point coordinates as (i,j), where i,j=0,1,2,3,4. The following 10 diagonals can be selected: (0,1)-(1,0), (1,1)-(2,0), (2,1)-(3,0), (3,1)-(4,0), (4,1)-(3,2), (0,3)-(1,2), (1,3)-(0,4), (2,3)-(1,4), (3,3)-(2,4), (4,3)-(3,4). These diagonals are respectively located in different small squares, and the 20 endpoints are all different; the interiors of different small squares do not overlap, so they have no common point at all. Therefore the upper bound 10 can be achieved.

raw_record.question_text: A square $4 \times 4$ table is divided into 16 unit squares. Find the maximum possible number of diagonals one can draw in these unit squares so that no two of them have any common point (including endpoints).

method.method_draft: First read the picture as a 4 by 4 array of unit squares, with 5 lattice points on each horizontal grid line. Split the board horizontally into two 2 by 4 strips: the top two rows and the bottom two rows. In any 2 by 4 strip, every diagonal drawn in one of its unit squares has exactly one endpoint on the middle horizontal grid line of that strip. Since that middle line has only 5 lattice points and endpoints may not be shared, a strip can contain at most 5 diagonals. Therefore the whole 4 by 4 board contains at most 5+5=10 diagonals. To show this is attainable, use coordinates (i,j), i,j=0,...,4, from the top-left lattice point. One valid set of 10 diagonals is: (0,1)-(1,0), (1,1)-(2,0), (2,1)-(3,0), (3,1)-(4,0), (4,1)-(3,2), (0,3)-(1,2), (1,3)-(0,4), (2,3)-(1,4), (3,3)-(2,4), (4,3)-(3,4). These lie in distinct unit squares and have no common endpoints, so the maximum is 10.

推理：把这个4×4棋盘水平分成上下两个2×4长条。先看任意一个2×4长条：其中每个小正方形的对角线都会恰好有一个端点落在这个长条的中间水平网格线上。这个中间水平网格线只有5个格点，而题目要求任意两条对角线没有公共点，包括端点，所以同一个2×4长条内最多只能画5条对角线。因此上半部分最多5条，下半部分最多5条，总数最多为5+5=10条。

(0,3)-(1,2), (1,3)-(0,4), (2,3)-(1,4), (3,3)-(2,4), (4,3)-(3,4)。
这些对角线分别位于不同的小正方形中，且20个端点互不相同；不同小正方形的内部不重叠，因此它们没有任何公共点。所以上界10可以达到。

method.method_draft: Model the picture as a finite graph/DP problem on the 5 by 5 lattice points of the displayed 4 by 4 grid. Process the four rows of cells from top to bottom. For one row of 4 cells, a cell choice is either no diagonal, the diagonal from top-left to bottom-right, or the diagonal from top-right to bottom-left. Maintain a 5-bit mask for which vertices on the current top grid line have already been used by diagonals in the previous row. For each of the 3^4 choices in the current row, reject it if two chosen diagonals use the same top or bottom vertex, if a chosen top vertex is already marked in the input mask, or if two diagonals are placed in the same cell. The chosen bottom vertices form the output 5-bit mask for the next row, and the number of chosen diagonals is added to the score. Initialize with the zero mask above the first row and run this transfer for 4 rows. The maximum DP value after the fourth row is 10. A predecessor trace gives, for example, the same 10-diagonal coordinate construction listed in Method 1, proving both optimality and attainability.

图像描述：附图显示的是一个空白的 4×4 方格表，外边框和内部网格线把大正方形分成 16 个单位小正方形；没有预先画出的对角线。因此可把所有交点看成 5×5 个格点。

推理：按照指定方法，把问题建模为 5×5 格点上的有限动态规划。每个单位方格最多有三种选择：不画对角线，画从左上到右下的对角线，或画从右上到左下的对角线。只要两条对角线共用端点，或在同一个小方格内同时出现两条对角线，就不允许。

逐行处理 4 行小方格。对当前行上边界的 5 个格点，用一个 5 位 mask 表示哪些点已经被上一行的对角线占用。枚举当前行 4 个小方格的 3^4 种选择，并拒绝以下情况：同一行内两条对角线共用上端点或下端点；某条对角线使用了输入 mask 中已被占用的上端点；同一小方格中出现两条对角线。当前行被使用的下端点形成下一行的输出 mask，画出的对角线数加入 DP 值。

初始化为第一行上方 mask=00000，DP 值为 0。对 4 行重复转移。由于每一行的所有 3^4 种合法/非法选择都被枚举，这个 DP 穷尽了所有可能画法。运行该转移后，第四行结束时所有输出 mask 中的最大 DP 值为 10，因此最多不能超过 10。

还需要说明 10 可以达到。用坐标 (x,y) 表示格点，x,y=0,1,2,3,4，y 从上到下。可以画如下 10 条对角线：
第 1 行：从 (1,0) 到 (0,1)，从 (2,0) 到 (3,1)，从 (3,0) 到 (4,1)；
第 2 行：从 (1,1) 到 (0,2)，从 (2,1) 到 (1,2)；
第 3 行：从 (2,2) 到 (1,3)，从 (3,2) 到 (2,3)，从 (4,2) 到 (3,3)；
第 4 行：从 (0,3) 到 (1,4)，从 (4,3) 到 (3,4)。
这些线段分别位于单位方格的对角线上，同一行内不共用端点，相邻行在公共水平格线上的端点集合也互不相交，所以没有两条对角线有公共点。于是最大值确为 10。

Image description: In the attached figure there is a square grid, divided by 3 vertical lines and 3 horizontal lines into 4 columns and 4 rows, for a total of 16 small squares; on each horizontal grid line there are 5 grid points.

Reasoning: Divide this 4×4 chessboard horizontally into upper and lower two 2×4 strips. First look at any one 2×4 strip: the diagonal of each small square in it will have exactly one endpoint falling on the middle horizontal grid line of this strip. This middle horizontal grid line has only 5 grid points, and the problem requires that any two diagonals have no common point, including endpoints, so within the same 2×4 strip at most 5 diagonals can be drawn.
